scripts.storybook: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm registry:build && node --import tsx scripts/storybook.ts stylex
scripts.storybook:upstream: pnpm upstream:prepare && node --import tsx scripts/storybook.ts upstream
scripts.build:upstream: pnpm upstream:prepare && cross-env ARIAX_IMPLEMENTATION=upstream storybook build -o dist/upstream
scripts.build:stylex: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm registry:build && cross-env ARIAX_IMPLEMENTATION=stylex storybook build -o dist/stylex
scripts.build: pnpm registry:build && pnpm build:upstream && pnpm build:stylex
scripts.test:install: node --import tsx --test scripts/install-fixtures.test.ts scripts/registry-sources.test.ts && pnpm registry:build && node --import tsx scripts/test-install.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm test:upstream && pnpm upstream:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm registry:build && pnpm test && pnpm test:install && pnpm build:upstream && pnpm build:stylex
